_doc: Between-run systems for the Abbey of the Threshold. Prices are in ostia. Read by scripts/abbey.gd.

Debt.rule: +8 ostia after every descent they come home from.

Penance.text: A crime to be worked off at the door.

Vengeance.text: Someone they loved was taken by a world.
Vengeance.rule: +1 Might, but begins every descent with 10 stress.

Faith.text: They believe the descents are holy.

Hunger.text: They want what is on the other side.

dread.name: Lift the Dread
dread.text: Remove one Dread card from the deck.

mend.name: Mend the Shattered
mend.text: A Shattered hero may descend again.

food.name: Blessed bread
food.text: One step of food. With none, every hero takes stress.

light.name: Candles
light.text: Two steps of light. In the dark, foes grow stronger.

medicine.name: Wenna's tinctures
medicine.text: Treats an injury on the road.

beds.name: More beds
beds.text: The Guesthouse keeps two more heroes.

altar.name: Relic altar
altar.text: The company may carry one more relic into a descent.

bellows.name: New bellows
bellows.text: Mother Hild's tempering costs a third less.

pages.drowned: Brother Lucan writes: the doors were not built. They were found, standing, in a ring around the abbey's foundations.
pages.mire: The oldest charter does not call the abbey a house of God. It calls it a lid.
pages.baths: Every world's ruler held its Tooth as if it had been given to them, never as if they had found it.
pages.pits: The Teeth are warm. Sister Ide says they are warmer when the company is in the church.
pages.foundry: The Grey around the abbey is not fog. It is the place where nothing belongs to any course.
pages.coast: The first Abbot wrote that the sealed door breathes on feast days. The page was cut out. Lucan found the stub.
pages.fleet: Six courses once ran together through one body. She was the world, before the world broke.
pages.rime: She did not die when she fell. She fell open, and her mouth came down on the Limen.
pages.barrow: The Barrow King sealed his own door to keep her out. The order called that heresy and burned his name.
pages.hive: Prior Aldric's ledgers count Teeth, not dead. Lucan has checked them twice.
pages.spire: The Abbot listens at the sealed door at night. In the morning he will not say what it asked him.
pages.silence: Every Tooth brought home loosens the door. The order has known this since the first descent.
pages.pyre: To seal the door forever, the Teeth must be given back. To open it, they must be set into it.
pages.garden: There is a third way written in a hand Lucan does not recognise: a living body could hold all six courses in her place.
pages.sky: Heaven did not abandon the world. It fell, and the abbey was built on the place where it landed.

guesthouse.name: The Hosteller
hello: Sign, or be signed for.
The beds are aired. Mostly.
Another face. I'll remember it.

almonry.name: Brother Fenn
hello: Alms are free. Goods are not.
Every ostium goes back to the order. I keep very good books.
Mind the shelves. Mind the price.

smithy.name: Mother Hild
hello: The coal's from the Foundry. It doesn't go out. Neither do I.
Put it on the anvil. Let's see what's left of it.
Steel remembers. So do I.

infirmarium.name: Sister Wenna
hello: On the table. Don't touch the jars.
I kept a barrow company alive for nine days. You'll keep.
Vinegar first. Then we'll talk.

cellarium.name: Godric
hello: Count it twice. Then count it again.
Bread's blessed. Candles are counted. Don't waste either.
The Fleet ran out of everything. We won't.

sacristy.name: Sister Ide
hello: Give it here. Let me feel how cold it is.
The Teeth are warm today.
I don't need eyes for this work.

scriptorium.name: Brother Lucan
hello: Everything is written down. Even you.
I have a page for every one of them. Sit, if you must.
Mind the ink. It is older than you.

chapter.name: Prior Aldric
hello: The order provides. The order also keeps accounts.
Sign the vows, and the door will treat you as you deserve.
Every Tooth you bring home is a prayer answered.
